issue_context.title: Add Console output support for Android
issue_context.body:
The iOS/tvOS version was added in #33667. We need to migrate also the Android version using logcat using similar implementation technique. The code which could be used as a base lives at https://github.com/mono/mono/blob/master/mcs/class/corlib/System.IO/LogcatTextWriter.cs

/cc @steveisok

review_comments: I don't like p/invoking directly into liblog. It feels much better to do it like we do for iOS and go into pal_log.c.

@akoeplinger  why is it better? it's extra code and Interop* stuff tends to do direct pinvokes if it's possible, e.g. all these https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/src/libraries/Common/src/Interop/OSX/Interop.Libraries.cs#L9-L11
also it will increase `libSystem.Native.so` dynamic lib size as I will have to link some android lib

Hm yeah after thinking about it it might be fine, I got thrown off by 1) thinking the `__` are due to C++ name mangling but it's actually documented that way so should be fine from a stability point and 2) it's different to how we do it in mono/mono but again that should be fine.
Just checking, it's Unicode rather than UTF8?

`Encoding.Unicode` here just tells the Console to dump `System.String` "as is" without unicode->utf8 conversion to ` void Write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int count)` where I call that logcat method and convert byte-array back to string and let the marshaller do the conversion to utf8 with `\0` in the end. The workflow can be improved to reduce a couple of allocations, not sure it worth doing now - this is needed to unblock the test runner.
